detail.longDescription: Anthropic Launches # ClaudeDuet , a Proactive AI Agent for Professionals # Anthropic is entering the growing AI agent market with Claude Duet, a new assistant designed to handle tasks proactively rather than simply responding to prompts. Key capabilities include: • Proactive assistance: Delivers daily briefings and monitors connected apps for items that need attention. • Task automation: Handles scheduling, drafts communications, builds dashboards, and creates financial forecasts and web applications. • Background execution: Uses its own cloud computer and browser to complete tasks while users focus on other work. • Human oversight: Requires user approval for sensitive actions, including sending messages and making payments. • Broad integrations: Connects with more than 6,000 tools and plugins through the Claude ecosystem. Currently available as a research preview through a waitlist for US Claude Pro and Max subscribers, Duet signals intensifying competition among Anthropic, OpenAI, and Meta to build AI agents that can independently manage real-world workflows. The challenge ahead is ensuring these agents are reliable, secure, and capable of making sound decisions with minimal human intervention. # ArtificialIntelligence # AIAgents # Anthropic # ClaudeAI # Automation # FutureOfWork # TechInnovation https://www. theverge.com/ai-artificial-int elligence/1015843/anthropic-claude-duet-ai-agent
